_comment: Verifier profiles. argv runs with shell=False in a temporary detached checkout of the EXACT revision, sanitized env, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, any __pycache__/*.pyc purged and -X pycache_prefix=<private dir>. Python profiles must use the TRUSTED runner (omo_grok/trusted_runner.py, outside the candidate tree, run with -I): it runs the suite, snapshots test machinery/builtins against tampering and writes a nonce-bound JSON result outside the checkout; a pass needs exit 0 AND the result AND every expected_tests id passed AND exact counts AND type_checks. Before running, the candidate diff is rejected for: protected_paths, paths outside editable_paths, hook files, top-level stdlib/verifier shadowing, non-source/bytecode/binary/symlink files (source_extensions allowlist) and static_scan AST findings (allow/forbid lists; scanning cannot be disabled). Non-python profiles need exit_code_only: true (reduced assurance). OMO_VERIFY_TEMPLATE anywhere fails closed.

example-template-do-not-use._comment: Copy and replace with a real project test command. While the marker is present this profile fails closed.
